summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong Listing Rules, reporting an on-market share repurchase on May 27, 2026. The registrant bought back 656,000 ordinary shares at HKD 19.783 per share, representing 0.0696% of existing issued shares, which were held as treasury shares. The buyback was authorized by the board and complies with applicable listing rules. This is a capital return via open-market repurchase. What to watch: pace of ongoing buyback program and potential cancellation of treasury shares.
